source.workingTree: Verified working-tree changes on merged #1123. Selected-byte fingerprint identifies actual source, not a future commit. Foundation artifacts were freshly built; tarball hashes identify installed native/core artifacts and runtime source was separately emitted/bundled for every consumer.

fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of a UTF-8 manifest: one line per selected file, lowercase SHA-256(file bytes), two ASCII spaces, repo-relative path, LF; unique paths sorted by JavaScript default string ordering.
fingerprint.selection: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- <pathspecs>; existing files minus excludedPaths, including new tests. Local research/planning files are outside these paths. Evidence excludes itself to avoid self-reference.
